subject.title: feat: add supply eas deploy workflow with version bump selector

question: Should Supply Deploy be allowed to push version-bump commits to the selected branch and auto-submit release builds to store destinations from a manual GitHub Action?
rationale: This is a release-operations policy choice: the code is a useful implementation path, but automation with contents write, EXPO_TOKEN, and store submission changes who can trigger release side effects.

options.title: Require guarded deploy proof first
options.body: Keep this direction, but require branch-history cleanup, pinned EAS CLI, and redacted beta or dry-run proof before considering merge.

options.title: Accept as release-owned automation
options.body: A release owner can explicitly accept the contents-write and production-draft behavior as the intended operating model.

options.title: Pause until release policy is clearer
options.body: Leave the PR draft or close it if the team wants a different release mechanism than a GitHub Action that commits and submits builds.

recommendation.title: Require guarded deploy proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this direction, but require branch-history cleanup, pinned EAS CLI, and redacted beta or dry-run proof before considering merge.
